home: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent RGBA sprite atlas for cozy isometric farming game Lang Mam. Create ONE sprite sheet of the SAME charming farmhouse, with exactly 4 columns and 6 rows = 24 isolated sprites. Columns rotate the building around its vertical axis by 0,90,180,270 degrees respectively: front-right, rear-right, rear-left, front-left views. Camera fixed orthographic elevated 35 degrees, no perspective. Rows are upgrade tiers 1,5,10,15,20,25: humble timber cottage with slate blue roof and terracotta chimney; add porch; add stone foundation; add side wing; add dormers and elegant balcony; grand warm country farmhouse. Each row keeps IDENTICAL architecture between its four viewpoints; genuinely show all four sides, never mirror a facade. Style premium hand-painted faux 3D mobile farm art, warm textured timber, cream plaster, blue slate roof, soft upper-left daylight, coherent subdued palette, clean solid silhouettes. Uniform 4x6 grid no borders, every sprite centered within equal cells, full building including foundation fits with 10% transparent margins, bottom ground anchor at 90% of each cell, same scale within each row. Transparent background, actual alpha, no backdrop, no ground tiles, no cast shadows, no captions or letters, no people, no framing. Make a large high-resolution sheet at 2048x3072 if possible.
